findings.message: The defs declare entry.params.despesaId (select:detalheDespesa) but no method that selects. Added public selectDespesa(id | null), which publishes selectedDespesa and loads the record into despesa through obterDespesa.

Entry params status and page filter listaMinhasDespesas but no state holds them. Added persisted states filtroStatus and filtroPage; listarMinhasDespesas(status?, page?, append) publishes them and sends them in the query input.

registrarDespesa and salvarCorrecao are filled in through formularioDespesa but the defs have no <command>.input state. Added registrarDespesaDraft and salvarCorrecaoDraft with setters setRegistrarDespesaDraft and setSalvarCorrecaoDraft; the correction draft is prefilled from the opened expense.
registrarDespesa input requires colaboradorId from the session, but the shared has no identity source it may import. It sends an empty string; the backend must take the colaborador from the session.
The form organism mentions the proof (comprovante) but no route or field of the contract carries it (it is attached by the document attachment capability), so the shared has no member for it.

Commands return despesa and item but no state has them as source. Applied despesa to the despesa state and selectedDespesa, and item upserted (or removed when it no longer matches filtroStatus) in despesas, without reloading.
